skirmish.module.inventory_theme.name: Inventory Theme
skirmish.module.inventory_theme.descript: The inventory, chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers and dispensers in a dark rounded Skirmish panel with rounded slots instead of vanilla's grey texture. Layout and clicks stay vanilla; server menus with their own picture are left alone.
Chests, barrels, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers and server menus built on them
